comparison.objective: Recover two stranded slot cars while another car continues racing.
comparison.physical_skill: Assigned-arm pickup and precise insertion into moving-lane conditions while avoiding protected cars.
comparison.success_condition: Each released car remains lane-engaged and travels 100 mm independently; protected-car contact zeros the score.
comparison.reason: Tests obstacle-aware recovery and lane insertion, not damper adjustment or retention. Body omits detailed insertion tolerances, but the tested objective is clearly different.
